# sprint topic authentication

Package: `@hyungjuk/sprint` · Version: `1.1.0`

[CLI index](../../README.md) · [Parent](../topic.md)

## Help

```text
NAME
  sprint topic authentication — Configure Sprint sessions, profiles and private automation-token files.

SYNOPSIS
  sprint topic authentication [FLAGS]

DESCRIPTION
  Configure Sprint sessions, profiles and private automation-token files.

EXAMPLES
  sprint whoami --non-interactive
  sprint login --token-file /absolute/private/token.json --non-interactive

POSITIONAL ARGUMENTS
  None; see SYNOPSIS for required input flags.

FLAGS
  No command-specific flags.

GLOBAL FLAGS
  --help, -h                 Show command help without authentication or network.
  --schema [DOMAIN]          Print API action contracts as JSON; not CLI flag syntax.
  --llms [DOMAIN]            AI guide; DOMAIN selects action-contract JSON.
  --profile NAME             Select a private Sprint profile (default: default).
  --token-file FILE          Use an owned mode 0600 automation-token JSON file.
  --non-interactive          Never prompt; startup auto-update is skipped.
  --wait                     Observe an accepted job without retrying the mutation.
  --timeout SECONDS          Wait timeout, 1..3600; requires --wait (default: 30).

OUTPUT
  output text on stdout; errors on stderr.

AUTHENTICATION
  No existing Sprint session required. Business login/public commands still require an explicit server origin.

NOTES
  SSO onboarding: sign in with AxHub on the web, issue a scoped automation token with a private 0600 output file, then run sprint login --token-file /absolute/private/token.json --non-interactive to verify it. Subsequent CLI and MCP commands keep --token-file; Hub cookies are never copied. Password login is disabled on SSO deployments. Default profile preserves session.json; named profiles use profiles/NAME/session.json. Private directories 0700, files 0600, current owner, no symlinks. --token-file FILE reads {baseURL,token}; never combine it with --profile or another origin. --non-interactive never prompts. Automation create requires session authentication and exclusive --output-file; metadata only on stdout. Default expiry 8 hours, maximum 30 days. Actions and projects intersect current owner permissions. Project-scoped credentials deny unscopable/global operations; identity is always a safe self-introspection read. Native field grants accept only their declared fields and transition values; mixed patches require a matching single field grant or explicit generic update scope. Approval/rejection, role kind, graduation date and history supersedes select distinct actions. Client-only read aliases listed in unsupportedAutomationAliases are rejected at issuance; canonical alternatives return broader server DTOs.
  Session: XDG_CONFIG_HOME/work-execution/session.json; default ~/.config/work-execution/session.json. Directories 0700, files 0600; no symlinks.
  npm login authorizes package publishing, not the Sprint HTTP service.

SEE ALSO
  sprint help topic
  sprint topic output
  Documentation: https://github.com/Hyungjuk42/sprint-docs/blob/main/cli/reference/topic/authentication.md
```
